integrity: All assertions have a complete analytic proof. Included Python 3 checker reproduces finite exact-rational vertex/cone and coefficient identities. Finite checks are not a replacement for universal arguments.
limitations: Exact tail proven for positive squared-radius deficits below 1/64 in the unscaled covolume-one-half BCC cell; no sharpness claim for this interval, no entire CDF and no new optimality among lattices; historical priority subject to independent review.
title: Exact radial endpoint law of the BCC Voronoi truncated octahedron
